description:
## Why

Per stance bead PKIX-ztmr, the project commits to **Level 3 OSCAL alignment**: OSCAL is the source of truth for lint catalogs, profile composition, deviations, and assessment findings. The Rust types in `pkix-lint` and `pkix-profiles` become typed views over OSCAL data, not bespoke shapes.

This epic delivers the alignment. It blocks several downstream work items:

- PKIX-amgn.5 (refactor pkix-lint to framework + RFC-conformance lints) should ship the OSCAL-shaped types in its refactor, not bespoke-then-realign.
- PKIX-amgn.3 (create pkix-lint-cabf) should author its content AS an OSCAL Catalog from day one.
- PKIX-8mzp, PKIX-dbhe, PKIX-nlxl all reshape under this alignment (see those beads' updated descriptions / WONTFIX rationale).

## What

Seven children, executed roughly in order:

- `.1` **OSCAL model coverage audit** — which OSCAL models we touch (Catalog, Profile, Assessment Results, Finding, Observation, Risk), which Rust types map to each, what's out of scope (Component Definition, SSP, Assessment Plan beyond minimal subset, etc.).
- `.2` **OSCAL Rust binding choice** — existing crate (e.g. `oscal-rs`, evaluate maturity), hand-rolled subset matching the NIST JSON Schema, or generated from JSON Schema. Decision recorded; one path forward.
- `.3` **`EvaluationReport` realign to OSCAL Assessment Results** — field-for-field correspondence. Serialization round-trips against NIST OSCAL schema.
- `.4` **`Finding` realign to OSCAL Finding + Observation** — including evidence-pointer fields (`links`, `props`) so PKIX-a86q's `cert_sha256` lands as an OSCAL Link / Prop.
- `.5` **`Deviation` / `DeviationStore` realign to OSCAL Risk + Risk store** — Risk objects with status=deviation-approved, remediation references, subject-scoping via OSCAL's existing mechanisms.
- `.6` **Lint-as-Control mapping** — each `Lint` impl declares its OSCAL Control metadata (id, title, description, parameters, parts). Rust type stays for executable side; OSCAL Control is canonical metadata.
- `.7` **Profile composition via OSCAL Profile semantics** — bundle composition (A ∪ B − {X}) uses OSCAL Profile chaining + import/modify/select directives. Rust ergonomics layer wraps the OSCAL semantics but does not invent its own.

## Acceptance

- [ ] All children closed.
- [ ] `pkix-lint` types are OSCAL-shaped and round-trip cleanly to OSCAL JSON.
- [ ] At least one lint Catalog (the RFC-conformance bundle in `pkix-lint`) authored as / serialized as an OSCAL Catalog.
- [ ] At least one Profile (the CAB cabf.br.tls bundle in `pkix-lint-cabf` once it exists) authored as / serialized as an OSCAL Profile.
- [ ] CI cross-validates the workspace's emitted OSCAL JSON against the NIST OSCAL JSON Schema (or equivalent oscal-cli check).
- [ ] AGENTS.md non-negotiable updated to reflect Level 3 commitment.
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry for the alignment.

## Out of scope

- Becoming an OSCAL Catalog Authority for non-PKIX content (NIST 800-53, PCI DSS, HIPAA, etc. — not our turf).
- OSCAL Rego rule mappings.
- OSCAL Component Definition / SSP / Assessment Plan beyond the minimal subset needed for Assessment Results to be self-contained.

## Filed as

Implements PKIX-ztmr stance. Blocks PKIX-amgn.3, PKIX-amgn.5 from shipping bespoke shapes.
notes:
Marked human 2026-05-11: this epic's entire dependency DAG roots at PKIX-9vnx.2 (OSCAL Rust binding choice — labeled human) and PKIX-ztmr (stance — labeled human). All non-human children (.3-.7) transitively block on .2. The umbrella cannot make autonomous progress until the binding choice lands. Re-evaluate when PKIX-9vnx.2 closes.
Architecture decided 2026-05-11 (Mark): **Architecture 2 — interpreter, not binding.** See PKIX-ztmr for full rationale.

Acceptance criteria reshape under Arch 2:

- ~~pkix-lint types are OSCAL-shaped and round-trip cleanly to OSCAL JSON~~ → pkix-lint emits OSCAL Assessment Results JSON that validates against the NIST OSCAL schema; consumes OSCAL Catalog/Profile JSON when configured to.
- ~~At least one lint Catalog authored as an OSCAL Catalog~~ → at least one lint Catalog *serializes to* an OSCAL Catalog (RFC-conformance bundle).
- ~~At least one Profile authored as an OSCAL Profile~~ → at least one Profile (cabf.br.tls) *consumed from* an OSCAL Profile JSON document.
- CI cross-validates emitted OSCAL JSON against the NIST schema (unchanged).
- AGENTS.md non-negotiable #5 text updated to reflect Arch 2 framing (interpreter, not 1:1 mirror).
- CHANGELOG entry for the alignment (unchanged).

Children .3-.7 stand but their descriptions need reframing from 'realign Rust types' to 'add OSCAL serializer/parser.' Notes appended to each.

PKIX-9vnx.2 (binding choice) closes — the question dissolves.

do-beads loop hygiene 2026-05-11: applying the human label that the notes block already says was applied. Without the label, this epic keeps surfacing at the top of bd ready every session. Blocked transitively on PKIX-ztmr stance + PKIX-9vnx.2 binding choice (the latter dissolved per Architecture 2, but no autonomous frontier reopens until ztmr lands).
Human label removed 2026-05-11 (Mark): green light to proceed under Arch 2 (interpreter, not binding). All architectural decisions are settled — PKIX-ztmr ratified the stance (now AGENTS.md non-negotiable #5), .2 dissolved, data-model side (.3/.4/.5/.10/.11) shipped, AGENTS.md updated (.8). Remaining children .6/.7/.9 are pure implementation work with clear scope and decomposition. Autonomous loop owns the work from here. Cascade unblocks PKIX-amgn.5, PKIX-amgn.8, PKIX-9vnx.9, and transitively PKIX-hbzo.1 + PKIX-jbvb test fixture options.
Superseded 2026-05-12 (PKIX-ncab.1, decision B): OSCAL demoted from 'source of truth' to one supported output format. Title renamed to reflect that this epic delivered the OSCAL emit/parse code that remains in tree (and remains functional) but no longer represents a workspace-wide alignment goal. Closed children .1-.8, .10, .11 remain as decision-history for how the shipped emit/parse surface came to be. Single open child .9 (check_shape) is handled separately per PKIX-ncab.3 (framing rework, API kept). See memory pkix-oscal-demoted-2026-05-11.
title: OSCAL emit/parse: workspace adapter for OSCAL output (re-roled under three-mode model)
